title: Canon Marks 15 Years of the Cinema EOS System
desc: Melville, NY, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Canon U.S.A., Inc., a leader in digital imaging solutions, today announced that its parent company, Canon Inc., is celebrating the 15th anniversary of the Cinema EOS System this month. Launched in 2011 for professional video production, Cinema EOS products are now used across a wide range of productions, from films and television dramas to documentaries, live streaming, corporate video, and virtual production. To date, 17 Cinema EOS cameras and 53 Cinema EOS lenses have been released globally.
